headline: Names the Postal Service building at 220 Elm Avenue in Munising, Michigan, the "Elizabeth L. Kinnunen Post Office Building."
what_it_does: This law gives a specific post office in Munising, Michigan an official name honoring Elizabeth L. Kinnunen. It only changes the building's designation. It does not change how mail is handled, what services the office offers, or who works there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the naming took effect on that date.
